question: Does the restocking fee apply to customers on contract pricing?
why_it_matters: Three large contracts say "returns at no charge". The rule engine needs a per-customer override or those accounts need review every time.

question: When inspection contradicts the customer's reason, who pays the freight already spent?
why_it_matters: A customer selects "shipped wrong part", gets a prepaid label, and inspection finds they ordered that part. The policy is silent.

question: Should top accounts be credited at approval instead of after inspection?
why_it_matters: Sales wants advance credit for about 40 accounts. AR is against it. It changes the status model and the credit integration.

question: How are broken-pack quantities handled?
why_it_matters: Fasteners sell in boxes of 100. A customer returning 60 loose pieces cannot be restocked as a box. No rule exists.

question: How far back can the ERP API return invoice lines?
why_it_matters: Warranty periods run to 24 months but the invoice search is specified at 18. IT has not confirmed what the API can serve.

question: Can aerosols and other hazardous items be returned at all?
why_it_matters: They are on the non-returnable list, but carriers have their own rules if an exception is granted. A label may not be legal to issue.

question: Who at a customer is allowed to request a return?
why_it_matters: Some customers want any buyer to do it. Others want only a purchasing manager. Customer-side roles are not in scope today.

question: What happens to drop-shipped items?
why_it_matters: About 6% of lines ship from the supplier directly and never touch a Tessmar warehouse. Should they come back to Tessmar or go to the supplier?

question: Is sales tax recalculated on a partial credit?
why_it_matters: B-stock outcomes credit a percentage of the line. Finance has not said how tax follows.

question: Do local customers still hand returns to the delivery driver?
why_it_matters: Roughly one in eight returns comes back on a Tessmar truck with no label. The driver needs a way to scan or log it.

question: Does a kit come back whole or by component?
why_it_matters: Seal kits and bearing kits are invoiced as one line. Customers often return one unused component.
